_comment: Engram configuration. Replace {AGENT_ID}, {COLLECTION_NAME}, and {MODEL_ID} with your values. See SKILL.md for full docs.

qmd._collections_comment: Maintenance allowlist for heartbeat qmd embed/update. Keep vertical/child access collections registered in QMD, but do not add them here; child workspaces maintain their own embeddings.
qmd._maintenance_comment: legacy keeps current update/embed behavior. shadow additionally records cheap dirty generations but never runs maintenance. coordinated is reserved for the coordinator rollout.

models._comment: Model ids for the heartbeat orchestrator and its subagents. The orchestrator is configured independently from subagent defaults.

heartbeat._comment: The cron orchestrator model is independent. Per-label subagent overrides fall back to models.default. Labels: hb-extract, hb-synthesis, hb-domains, hb-domains-write, hb-rethink, hb-rethink2, hb-autoresearch

cron._comment: Heartbeat schedule. Use cron expression (UTC). Avoid overlapping slots if running multiple workspaces. See AGENTS.md §5 for slot table.
